InteractionGym

Demo release · v0.1Code on GitHub

Interactive demo · a closed-loop simulation environment for full-duplex spoken agents

Three recorded episodes, replayed with each service's measured wall-clock time. Simulated time advances only once every component has responded, so the clock holds while the user simulator, a tool or a model is working and otherwise runs faster than real time.

    Data and licences. Episode B’s first user turn (recording housing_18), its task, tool schemas, mock APIs and agent instructions come from Full-Duplex-Bench v3 and are licensed CC BY-NC 4.0: non-commercial use only. Episode C’s first user turn is from the Easy Turn test set (Apache-2.0). Background ambience in A and C: DEMAND (Thiemann, Ito & Vincent 2013), recordings DLIVING (A) and DWASHING (C), channel 1, licensed CC BY-SA 3.0; the user audio of A and C, which mixes them in, is shared under the same licence. B has no DEMAND ambience (a synthetic room tone), since its CC BY-NC recording cannot be mixed into a CC BY-SA work. Noise events: MUSAN (Snyder, Chen & Povey 2015; CC BY 4.0), clips noise-free-sound-0815 (dog bark, A and B) and noise-free-sound-0320 (door slam, C), Freesound recordings marked public domain in MUSAN’s ANNOTATIONS. All other speech was generated by the simulator (Qwen3-TTS) or by the agents under test.
